body.x: Ninewatt (CEO Youngrok Kim) participated in the ‘Pre-CES2025 IFEZ,’ held on November 13 (Wednesday) at the Grand Ballroom C of Songdo Convensia.

Ninewatt is a startup that provides solutions to improve energy efficiency and reduce building carbon emissions. Using building energy modeling and public data, the company diagnoses buildings’ current energy efficiency and suggests optimal energy renovation scenarios.

Its flagship products include the energy renovation platform ‘WATTI,’ accessible to all users, ‘SAVE-E’ for urban energy consumption analysis, and ‘Insight-E’ for reducing electricity costs. Ninewatt’s energy solutions are implemented in regions such as Gangnam District and Gyeonggi Province, and it is also collaborating with France and Japan to enter the global market. Additionally, Ninewatt has signed a service contract with Korea's largest power equipment manufacturer for power analysis and energy-saving algorithms.

At CES 2025, Ninewatt will showcase WATTI, a city-scale building diagnostic platform. The platform utilizes public data to prioritize buildings for energy renovation and predict energy and carbon reduction outcomes through renovation simulations. Municipalities can use it to make policy decisions on energy efficiency and carbon reduction, while energy efficiency businesses can more effectively identify target buildings.

Ninewatt targets government officials, power suppliers, and energy efficiency companies in the U.S. and Europe. Plans include collaborating with more than five overseas municipalities to conduct demonstration projects and launching a green remodeling platform called ‘Green Planner.’

Organized by the Incheon Free Economic Zone Authority (IFEZA) and Incheon Technopark, ‘Pre-CES2025 IFEZ’ is part of the 'Global Top 10 City Incheon Week' held in the third week of November. Integrating five related events, the event focuses on key themes like healthcare, bio, and smart cities. On November 13, the IFEZ Smart City Tech Conference and the CES2025 Incheon Pavilion showcase occurred concurrently.
